findings.message: "#b-mais" starts hidden, but its gsap.fromTo() makes it visible only in the from-vars and omits opacity/autoAlpha from the destination. Cold render workers restore the hidden authored state, so the encoded element can stay invisible even when sequential snapshots look correct.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 1` (or `autoAlpha: 1`) to the destination vars for "#b-mais" so every seek path establishes the visible end state explicitly.

findings.message: In timeline "main", a tween on scale of #sB-in ends at 14.600 s, 0.150 s after a later tween on scale ends at 14.450 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes scale back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 14.000 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.

In timeline "main", a tween on scale of #sE-in ends at 27.800 s, 0.040 s after a later tween on scale ends at 27.760 s. For that tail the earlier tween takes scale back and leaves its own end value on screen, so the later tween's end never shows. End the earlier tween by 27.060 s, or add overwrite: "auto" to the later tween.
